Here is the complete breakdown of the SSC CPO Paper 1 syllabus, organized clearly under the four main subject headings with numbered topics so you can track your preparation easily.

1. General Intelligence & Reasoning

1. Blood Relations (Family tree, coded relations, pointing to a person)
2. Analogies (Semantic, symbolic/number, and figural analogies)
3. Classification / Odd One Out (Word, number, letter, and figure classification)
4. Series (Number series, alphabet series, alphanumeric, and figural series)
5. Coding & Decoding (Letter shifting, number coding, symbol coding, mixed letter coding)
6. Syllogism (Statement and conclusion based on Venn diagrams)
7. Direction & Distance Sense (Turns, shadow-based, and shortest distance problems)
8. Order & Ranking (Row/column arrangement, height/weight comparison)
9. Seating Arrangement & Puzzles (Linear, circular, and floor-based puzzles)
10. Venn Diagrams (Logical relationship between three or more groups)
11. Mathematical Operations (Sign interchange, BODMAS-based equations)
12. Missing Number (Matrix and diagram-based number puzzles)
13. Word Formation & Dictionary Order (Arranging words logically or alphabetically)
14. Clock & Calendar (Finding days, angles, and time intervals)
15. Cube & Dice (Open dice, opposite faces, painted cubes)
16. Non-Verbal Reasoning (Paper folding & cutting, mirror & water images, embedded figures, figure completion, counting figures)
17. Critical Thinking & Problem Solving (Statement & assumptions, cause & effect, decision making)

2. General Knowledge & General Awareness

1. Current Affairs (National & international news, sports, awards, appointments, government schemes, summits — last 6 to 12 months)
2. Indian History (Ancient, Medieval, and Modern History; Indian National Movement)
3. Geography (Indian & World Geography; rivers, mountains, soil, climate, national parks, agriculture, minerals)
4. Indian Polity & Constitution (Fundamental Rights & Duties, Parliament, President, Judiciary, Constitutional Amendments, Panchayati Raj)
5. Economics & Finance (Basic economic terms, Union Budget, Economic Survey, Five-Year Plans, RBI & banking functions, inflation)
6. General Science (Physics, Chemistry, and Biology up to Class 10 level; diseases, vitamins, SI units, chemical formulas)
7. Static GK & Culture (Classical & folk dances, festivals, temples, books & authors, important days, headquarters of international organizations)
8. India & Its Neighbouring Countries (Borders, capitals, currencies, bilateral exercises, diplomatic relations)
9. Science & Technology (ISRO/DRDO missions, defence exercises, recent inventions, basic computer awareness)

3. Quantitative Aptitude

1. Number System (Divisibility rules, remainders, unit digit, factors, HCF & LCM)
2. Simplification & Approximation (BODMAS, fractions, decimals, surds & indices)
3. Percentage (Basic conversions, population/value changes, election & exam problems)
4. Ratio & Proportion (Compounded ratio, partnership, coin-based problems, age-related problems)
5. Average (Weighted average, consecutive numbers, replacement problems)
6. Profit, Loss & Discount (Cost price, selling price, marked price, successive discounts, dishonest dealer)
7. Simple & Compound Interest (Installments, difference between SI and CI, rate/time calculations)
8. Mixture & Alligation (Mixing liquids/items of different prices or concentrations)
9. Time & Work (Efficiency, alternate days, wages, Pipes & Cisterns)
10. Time, Speed & Distance (Average speed, relative speed, Trains, Boats & Streams, circular tracks)
11. Algebra (Basic algebraic identities, linear & quadratic equations, polynomials, surds)
12. Geometry (Lines & angles, triangles, congruence & similarity, circles, chords, tangents, quadrilaterals)
13. Mensuration (2D & 3D) (Area and perimeter of triangle, circle, square, rectangle; surface area and volume of cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone, sphere, prism, pyramid)
14. Trigonometry (Trigonometric ratios, standard angles, identities, Heights & Distances)
15. Data Interpretation (DI) (Bar graphs, pie charts, line graphs, tables, histograms)

4. English Comprehension

1. Reading Comprehension (Unseen passages with inference, tone, and vocabulary questions)
2. Cloze Test (Fill-in-the-blanks within a connected paragraph)
3. Spotting Errors (Grammar mistakes based on parts of speech, tenses, subject-verb agreement, articles, prepositions)
4. Sentence Improvement / Phrase Replacement (Correcting underlined parts of a sentence)
5. Fill in the Blanks (Single and double fillers testing grammar and context)
6. Synonyms & Antonyms (Words with similar and opposite meanings)
7. One-Word Substitution (Replacing a phrase or definition with a single word)
8. Idioms & Phrases (Meanings and usage of common English idioms)
9. Spelling Correction (Identifying correctly or incorrectly spelt words)
10. Active & Passive Voice (Sentence transformation across tenses)
11. Direct & Indirect Speech (Narration change for assertive, interrogative, and imperative sentences)
12. Para Jumbles / Sentence Rearrangement (Arranging PQRS sentences into a coherent paragraph)
You can review the complete SSC CPO Syllabus and Exam Pattern for official updates.
